item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the vicinity of the Luzon Strait in the middle and latter parts of next week.
